target_customer: Hospitals and revenue cycle management firms whose billing teams chase insurance claims by phone.
problem: Claim follow-up calls make up most of a billing team's workload and each call takes around 30 minutes.
business_model: Percentage of net collections recovered, nothing upfront (company site)
product_category: AI voice agents for healthcare revenue cycle

founders.name: Suhail Parry
previous_startups: Medical billing company with 200+ clients (outcome not stated)
founders.background_notes: YC calls him a 2x founder; founding engineer at Knowext and operator at Mediregi per YC page.

founders.name: David Day
founders.background_notes: Data scientist at UCSF auditing medical coding accuracy per YC page.

competitors.name: SuperDial
competitors.what: Voice AI agents that call payers for claim status and benefits
competitors.traction_then: 10,000+ monthly claim calls for one dental customer (secondary article)
competitors.funding_then: 15M Series A reported; date not shown in sources

competitors.name: Infinitus
competitors.what: Healthcare voice AI for payer calls
competitors.funding_then: about 102.9M per a rival's comparison page

technical_complexity.rationale: Voice agents that navigate payer phone trees and portals and write back to EHR and RCM systems, fine tuned on 1.2M+ call transcripts per YC.

defensibility.rationale: Call transcript data and EHR integrations help, but funded rivals offered the same service and voice AI was widely available.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copy found as of 2026-11.

market_need_then: Company reports 764K contracted ARR (428K live) after a July 2025 launch and 100 percent of pilots converting; one customer reports days in AR falling from 45 to 7 (all company reported).

branding.brand_signature: Luna, the named AI agent: 'Your claims don't chase themselves. Luna does.'

brand_strength.rationale: Product persona 'Luna' gives some character, but no press or community coverage of the brand was found.

outcome_analysis: LunaBill launched in July 2025 and reports 764K contracted ARR within months, with founders who ran medical billing operations. Funding is not verified and funded competitors such as SuperDial exist, so strong early traction is company reported and the outcome is still open.
notes: Funding conflicts across aggregators (Signalbase 100K, Extruct/Pitchbook about 500K, Caplight seed 2025-11-11 with 7.14M estimated valuation); none verified, so no round recorded. YC launch post also names Yash Raj as COO but the YC founder listing does not, so he is not listed as founder. Founder education not found. Competitor source dates not shown in snippets.
